changes.to: Tau Robotics publishes no hardware specifications: its site describes the robots only as humanoids with 3D-printed claw hands and antennae heads that work alongside a supervising human, able to walk stairs and use elevators (checked 2026-11-17). Press reports describe the body as a modified Unitree G1 with Tau's own cameras, grippers and compute, but the maker does not state this. Per-unit price, height, weight, payload, speed, battery and runtime are therefore left empty; the ~USD 55,000 and 132 cm / 35 kg figures in catalogues are not maker figures.
Humanoid that cleans homes and offices as an invite-only service in San Francisco, working with a human supervisor rather than being sold as a product.
